# National Museum of the United States Army

> > The official museum chronicling the history of the U.S. Army from the Revolutionary War through modern conflicts, featuring soldier biographies, artifacts, and educational resources.

The National Museum of the United States Army (NMUSA) preserves and presents the Army's story through biographical profiles of notable soldiers like George Washington, Dwight Eisenhower, and Ulysses S. Grant, virtual field trips exploring military equipment and tactics, and educational programs on topics ranging from the Continental Army to World War II leadership. The museum offers both physical group visits and digital learning experiences.

## Key Topics

- U.S. Army History
- Military Biography
- Revolutionary War
- Continental Army
- World War I
- World War II
- Military Leadership
- George Washington
- Dwight Eisenhower
- Ulysses S. Grant
- American Expeditionary Forces
- Virtual Field Trips
- Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
- Women in Military Service
- Native American Soldiers

## Soldier Biographies

- [Dwight David Eisenhower](https://www.thenmusa.org/biographies/dwight-david-eisenhower): Biography of Dwight D. Eisenhower, WWII Supreme Allied Commander
- [Nathanael Greene](https://www.thenmusa.org/biographies/nathanael-greene): Biography of Nathanael Greene, Revolutionary War Major General
- [Nancy Harkness Love](https://www.thenmusa.org/biographies/nancy-harkness-love): Biography of Nancy Harkness Love, WASP founder and WWII pilot
- [Modesto Cartagena de Jesus](https://www.thenmusa.org/biographies/modesto-cartagena-de-jesus): Biography of Modesto Cartagena, 65th Infantry Regiment soldier
- [Enid Mack Pooley](https://www.thenmusa.org/biographies/enid-mack-pooley): Biography of Enid Mack Pooley, WWI Hello Girl telephone operator
- [Alan G. Rogers](https://www.thenmusa.org/biographies/alan-g-rogers): Biography of Alan G. Rogers, Army chaplain and Gulf War veteran

## Virtual Field Trips & Educational Programs

- [Native American Soldiers and World War I](https://www.thenmusa.org/class/defining-american-native-american-soldiers-and-world-war-i-and-the-path-to-citizenship): Virtual field trip on Native American WWI soldiers and citizenship
- [Revolutionary War Soldier Load](https://www.thenmusa.org/virtual-rev-war-soldier-load): Virtual field trip on Revolutionary War Continental Army equipment

## Articles & Historical Features

- [The Tomb of the Unknown Soldier](https://www.thenmusa.org/articles/the-tomb-of-the-unknown-soldier): Article on Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at Arlington National Cemetery

## Leadership & Professional Development

- [Past Directors Seminars](https://www.thenmusa.org/past-directors-seminars): Past Directors Seminars on Army values and women military leaders
- [2023 Leadership Symposium](https://www.thenmusa.org/2023-leadership): 2023 Leadership Symposium on Army history and military leadership

## Visiting the Museum

- [Group Visits](https://www.thenmusa.org/group-visits): Group visit ticketing and admission information for museum tours
